tools.name: get_gift
tools.description: Use this to look up one numbered upgraded Telegram gift, for example Plush Pepe #9998: traits (model, backdrop, symbol), rarity, the published price estimate in Stars, TON and USD, recent sales and the active listing. tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Use this for a Telegram gift collection such as "Plush Pepe": lowest published price estimate in Stars, TON and USD, supply, the 24h and 7d change of its lowest ask (there is no longer price history), and its models with their price estimates and rarity. Do not use it for market-wide rankings (top_c

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Use this for one model of a collection (for example Plush Pepe / Heart): rarity, lowest estimate in Stars, TON and USD, price estimate by backdrop and observed asks and sale floors. The Telegram ask is a TON price (telegram_ask_ton); telegram_ask_stars is that ask at the display rate, approximate. D

tools.name: get_backdrop
tools.description: Use this for a backdrop colour such as "Black": rarity and observed prices. With a collection it gives that collection's backdrop; without one it lists every collection where the backdrop appears. Do not use it for models or symbols. The Telegram ask is a TON price (telegram_ask_ton); telegram_ask_s

tools.name: get_symbol
tools.description: Use this for a gift symbol (the pattern on a gift, for example "Ruby") and its rarity, in one collection or across all. If symbol data is not stored yet the result says available=false; do not guess a rarity. Do not use it for models or backdrops.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Use this only when the user names a Telegram @username and wants the gifts that profile publicly shows on its GiftChecker page (/u/<username>): counts, the valuation in Stars and up to 20 numbered gifts. Users who hid their page or are not known answer not_found. Never returns wallets or balances. D

tools.description: Use this for the latest completed sales of a collection or one model in the last 90 days, with price in TON, Stars and USD, the marketplace and the date. tools.name: where_to_buy
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to buy: the cheapest stored active listings of a collection, model, backdrop or one numbered gift, each with marketplace, price in Stars, TON and USD and the link that opens it, plus the stored Portals ask floor. tools.name: compare
tools.description: Use this to compare 2 to 5 collections ("Plush Pepe"), models ("Plush Pepe / Heart") or numbered gifts ("plushpepe-9998") by price estimate, rarity and supply in one call. An item that does not match is listed with suggestions. Do not use it for one item.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this when a name may be misspelled, is in Russian or you do not know the kind: fuzzy search over collection, model and backdrop names, returning the best matches with their giftcheckertg.com URLs. tools.name: price_in
tools.description: Use this only to convert a price in Telegram Stars into TON or USD at the display rates GiftChecker uses. Do not use it to look up what a gift costs.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
